name: manual_660c4a
claim: Verify a preview against its served build metadata, and recheck the exact loopback listener and HTTP response from a separate invocation after restarting it.

decisions.notes: Orama #534 preview originally served an older artifact. The command-scoped replacement initially returned the intended SHA then exited with its runner; the user-scoped loopback job remained reachable in a separate check. Build first and keep the old listener if the build fails.
